summary: This CSS rule adds a hidden easter egg message that only appears when someone prints a webpage. It inserts a small, centered footer message at the bottom of the printed page referencing the site's meerkat mascot, using unicode emoji and styling it subtly in gray.

explanations.6: @media print means these styles only apply when the page is being printed, not when viewed on screen.
explanations.7: body::after is a pseudo-element that creates a new piece of content that appears after the body element without being in the actual HTML.
explanations.8: The content property inserts text with unicode characters (\1F9AB is a meerkat emoji, \2014 is an em dash); this text only shows up in print.
explanations.9: position: fixed keeps the message anchored to the same spot on every printed page, rather than moving with the content.
